testcase.name: the runtime records the mutating flag and an abandoned write is never run again nor answered as a retryable timeout()
mutating and non-mutating runs in one sweep each get their own outcome, and a recorded unknown outcome is left alone()
an abandoned mutating run becomes an unknown outcome that is never retryable and is replayed as is()
an abandoned non-mutating run is a retryable timeout and starts again with a new attempt()
a caller that does not say is assumed to mutate - the safe side()
a run that is restarted after a retryable failure takes the mutating flag of the new call()
